content.body:
A very advanced single engine fighter design by 1940 standards, the Spitfire is certainly one of the most famous fighter planes of all time. Elegant and sleek with the famous elliptical wings, it was a dogfighters dream in low wing stressed metal monoplane designs. Fast and maneuverable, its only serious rival at the time was the Luftwaffes Bf109.
However the Mk.I suffered from comparatively weak armament in only having light machine guns, and fuel starvation to the engine when under negative G forces. These weak spots were all that held the Mk.I back in its early deployments, and as power and armament were increasedly added to the Spitfire in its later marques it truly fulfilled its design goals ... staying fast, climbing quickly, turning tightly and importantly having decent firepower to bring to bear on its opponents.
